verdicts.reason: Both put '$3' above '2 FOR', so the offer reads backwards. Both also shrink the FIZZBANG logo to an illegible pill crammed into a row with the CTA and body copy, and both make the price far too small for the banner. A keeps the can at a usable size, but it is stacked in an off-centre column with dead space on both sides. B is worse: the can is jammed against the left edge, the logo pill is even tinier, all the text is minuscule, and the right half of the canvas is empty.
